content.text: Software Revision | Release Date | Summary of Changes | Related Documents
3.0 | 2023-06-02 | Initial Series-7 release. | AEG-OM-700 Rev 1, AEG-MM-700 Rev 1
3.1 | 2024-02-14 | Minor HMI diagnostics screen updates. No change to sensors or setpoints. | AEG-OM-700 Rev 2

3.2 | 2025-09-30 | Pressure sensor PS-04 replaced by PS-04A. Normal HPU discharge pressure setpoint changed from 180 bar to 200 bar. See ECN-1042. | ECN-1042, AEG-OM-700 Rev 3, AEG-MM-700 Rev 2, AEG-CR-700 Rev 2

3.2.1 | 2025-11-18 | Documentation correction: Alarm A17 condition text no longer names a specific sensor (PS-04 or PS-04A) so it reads correctly on units at either revision. Alarm thresholds unchanged. See ECN-1058. | ECN-1058, AEG-AL-700 Rev 5
3.3 | 2026-04-07 (planned) | Scheduled: extended diagnostics logging. No sensor or setpoint changes currently planned. | Not yet published
